Janeshwar Mishra Park.text: Janeshwar Mishra Park is a park in Lucknow featured in the district administration’s travel and tourism gallery. Any story characters or discoveries placed here are fictional.

Rumi Gate.text: Rumi Gate, also called Rumi Darwaza, is a historic gateway near the Asafi Imambara in Lucknow. Its pointed arch is decorated with floral and leaf-like carvings.

The district administration describes construction of Rumi Darwaza and the Asafi Imambara during a famine as a means of supporting affected people. Keep this documented context distinct from invented characters and magic.
